{{Quote|You're a little bit behind the times, Ben. Maybe you need your own galactic map updated. More than two years ago, when the Jedi turned against Jacen at Kuat?''"<br />"''Yeah, and we set up shop on Endor for a while. What about it?''"<br />"''We pulled everyone off Dathomir when Jacen's government shut the school down. The Jedi have yet to reopen it.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]|<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
The '''Jedi Praxeum''' of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] was established by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Streen]] and [[Kirana Ti]] after the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]<ref name="JvS" /> to help in the recovery efforts there after the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Invasion of Dathomir (Yuuzhan Vong War)|subjugation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TUF" /> and to [[Jedi training/Legends|train]] the locals to become [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="JvS" />

Due to [[Darth Caedus]] holding the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Jedi Academy]] hostage during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the staff and students of the Jedi Praxeum of Dathomir were evacuated by the Jedi Order to a [[Jedi Outpost|base]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. As of [[43 ABY]], the Dathomiri Praxeum remained abandoned.<ref name="Backlash" />
